title: Steer the optimizer from the web app: fork a scene, pick clips to layer from ranked suggestions, queue jobs for local workers, rate the results
description:
User vision (2026-09-27): rate the scenes the optimizer generates, AND steer it asynchronously: choose which clip to try next from surfaced mash-up suggestions (CLAP and other analysis), which posts a job that worker nodes pick up to run new optimization runs, producing more candidates to rate and steer from. And: fork a scene, pick from a list of potential clips to layer over it, post a pending async job, a worker runs the optimizer on that scene + clip.

Why: every optimizer candidate so far layers over Ave House's fixed base (Ave dark loop + Funky Nurykabe bright loop), which the user feels don't go together well; the user should choose both the scene and the clip.

Loop:
1. Fork a scene (existing Score fork).
2. 'Find clips to layer' posts Job{kind:'suggest', input:{scoreId}}. A worker ranks library clips against the scene: CLAP timbre/genre fit (clap sidecars), surrogate clash/masking/rhythm (optimizer surrogate + fit-feature sidecars), tempo/key compatibility, the user's ratings; writes ClipSuggestion records {scoreId, sampleId, clip, rank, terms, reasons} with a preview (the clip region's audio).
3. The user picks one or more suggestions: Job{kind:'optimize', input:{scoreId, source, clip, roles?, seed, budget}}.
4. Local workers (scripts/worker.py) poll jobsByState=queued, claim with a conditional update (lease + workerId), run scripts/optimize.py constrained to the chosen clip (a new --source/--clip mode), publish the cycle (scripts/cycle.py publish), mark done/failed with the cycle id or error.
5. Listen page (PR #19) rates the scenes; verdicts feed suggestions and the next base.

New: ClipSuggestion model; Job kinds optimize/suggest and member-level create rights for them (Job is curator-only today); worker script with lease/heartbeat and the safe-run limits (disk!); optimizer single-clip mode; web: 'Find clips to layer' panel on the score page, suggestion list with previews and reasons, a Jobs view (queued/running/done with links to cycles). Local mode first (apricity serve), cloud after release.
